name: Amanda MacDonald-Creevey
story: Amanda MacDonald-Creevey was a GIS Analyst with Rayonier Matariki Forests when she presented the application of Sentinel-2 satellite data in forestry at the 2018 New Zealand Esri User Conference. The surviving presentation provides a technical record of operational earth-observation use in plantation forestry.
